name: team game prop line is that year's team's line, not the current roster's (executed-result parity)
description: Seed a player who switched teams between seasons -- ZTA on a 2023 REG week 1 game, ZTB on a 2024 REG week 1 game -- with a DraftKings CLOSE GAME_SPREAD market per game whose selection_pid is that year's team (line -3.5 in 2023, +1.5 in 2024), and a current_nfl_team of ZZZ that matches neither. Request the column over both weeks under a year+week row axis; each year's row must carry that year's team's line. Pre-item-6 team_game_prop_line_from_betting_markets joined on player.current_nfl_team, so both rows were null (the year correlation forces the cell's year and no market exists for the current team); the fix routes the join through player_year_teams -- the team the REG gamelogs assign to the player for that year, the game_opponent route -- exactly the wrong-team defect item 4 deliberately did not touch. Oracle values are the seeded selection lines, derived from the seed not from output.
expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023,2024]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('MLB')), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year WHERE nfl_year_week_timestamp.week IN (1)), "player_year_teams" as (select "pid", "year", (array_agg(nfl_team ORDER BY game_count DESC, nfl_team ASC))[1] as team from (select "player_gamelogs"."pid", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "player_gamelogs"."nfl_team", count(*) as "game_count" from "player_gamelogs" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "player_gamelogs"."esbid" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023, 2024) and "player_gamelogs"."season_year" in (2023, 2024) group by "player_gamelogs"."pid", "nfl_games"."season_year", "player_gamelogs"."nfl_team") as "player_year_team_counts" group by "pid", "year"), "tace59ca77b4d92a6244ce6fb5c22033f_markets" as (select "source_id", "source_market_id", "time_type", "nfl_games"."home_nfl_team", "nfl_games"."away_nfl_team", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week" as "week" from "prop_markets_index" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "prop_markets_index"."esbid" and "nfl_games"."season_year" = "prop_markets_index"."season_year" and nfl_games.nfl_week_id in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2024_REG_WEEK_1') where "market_type" = 'GAME_SPREAD' and "time_type" = 'CLOSE' and "source_id" = 'DRAFTKINGS' and "prop_markets_index"."season_year" in (2023, 2024)), "tace59ca77b4d92a6244ce6fb5c22033f" as (select "pms"."selection_pid", "m"."home_nfl_team", "m"."away_nfl_team", "m"."year", "m"."week", pms.selection_metric_line from "tace59ca77b4d92a6244ce6fb5c22033f_markets" as "m" inner join "prop_market_selections_index" as "pms" on "pms"."source_id" = "m"."source_id" and "pms"."source_market_id" = "m"."source_market_id" and "pms"."time_type" = "m"."time_type" where "pms"."selection_type" in ('OVER')), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023 UNION ALL SELECT pgl.pid, 2024::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2024 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2024) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023 UNION ALL SELECT pgl.pid, 2024::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2024 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2024) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2024_REG_WEEK_1') and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023, 2024)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2024_REG_WEEK_1') and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023, 2024))) as "g") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "tace59ca77b4d92a6244ce6fb5c22033f"."selection_metric_line" AS "team_game_prop_line_betting_market_0", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "player_year_teams" on "player_year_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_year_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" left join "tace59ca77b4d92a6244ce6fb5c22033f" on "tace59ca77b4d92a6244ce6fb5c22033f"."selection_pid" = "player_year_teams"."team" and tace59ca77b4d92a6244ce6fb5c22033f.year = player_years_weeks.year and tace59ca77b4d92a6244ce6fb5c22033f.week = player_years_weeks.week left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "tace59ca77b4d92a6244ce6fb5c22033f"."selection_metric_line", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
